Step: 1052 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception because 1052 mod 100 ≠ 0).  
Days from Apr 24 to end of year:  
Apr: 30-24 = 6 days left in April.  
May-Dec: 31+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 245 days.  
Total = 6 + 245 = 251 days left in 1052.  
219 days to add: first use 251 days of 1052? No, we are adding 219 days forward from Apr 24, 1052.  

From Apr 24:  
219 days = first 251 days of 1052 remaining is more than 219, so the date stays in 1052.  

Count forward:  
April: 6 days left → 6 days used (Apr 25–30). Remaining: 219-6=213 days.  
May (31) → 213-31=182 left.  
June (30) → 182-30=152 left.  
July (31) → 152-31=121 left.  
August (31) → 121-31=90 left.  
September (30) → 90-30=60 left.  
October (31) → 60-31=29 left.  
November (30) → 29 days into November = November 29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1052-11-29
